verdict.rationale: Airweave supports natural-language operation via its MCP server, CLI search, and agentic search (AI agents iteratively query using tool calling), plus published skills for agent environments like Cursor and Claude Code, letting AI-native users interact conversationally rather than through rigid APIs. However, core management tasks (creating collections, configuring source connections, auth) still appear to require the dashboard or REST API rather than natural language. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language control over configuration/admin actions (not just search), and independent hands-on confirmation of NL command quality.
